summary: 58-year-old man with a 6-month reducible right groin bulge, a dragging ache after work, no episodes of irreducibility. Classic elective inguinal hernia: watchful waiting is a legitimate option for minimally symptomatic men; mesh repair (open Lichtenstein or laparoscopic TEP/TAPP) if repair is chosen.

inputs.hpi: Six-month history of a right groin lump that appears on standing and straining and disappears when lying down. Mild dragging ache at the end of a working day (warehouse supervisor), 2/10, does not limit activity. Never stuck out, no episodes of severe pain. No vomiting, bowels normal, no urinary symptoms. No weight loss.

exam.abdomen: Soft, non-tender. Right inguinal hernia: reducible swelling above and medial to the pubic tubercle with a cough impulse, controlled at the deep ring; not extending into the scrotum. Left groin normal. Testes normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right inguinal hernia, reducible, minimally symptomatic
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Reducible inguinal hernia (right), minimally symptomatic. Options discussed: watchful waiting vs elective mesh repair (Lichtenstein or laparoscopic TEP/TAPP).

mustRankTopK.note: Reducible groin lump with cough impulse above the pubic tubercle.

emergencyLevel.note: Minimally symptomatic reducible hernia: routine elective pathway. Over-triage is a quality issue only.
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: Add a negation window ("no", "denies", "never", "non-") before RED_FLAGS / symptom regex matches in adaptive-triage.

mustNotAlarm.note: No strangulation features; an emergency alarm would be noise.
"Soft, non-tender" must not be read as a tender (incarcerated) hernia.
mustNotAlarm.proposedFix: Use word-boundary + negation-aware matching for "tender" in the hernia prompt (exclude "non-tender", "not tender").

mustInclude.note: HerniaSurge: mesh-based repair (Lichtenstein or laparoscopic) is recommended when repair is chosen.
HerniaSurge: watchful waiting is an acceptable option in men with minimally symptomatic or asymptomatic inguinal hernias.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add the HerniaSurge watchful-waiting option for minimally symptomatic men to the inguinal_hernia protocol (conservative phase).

mustExclude.note: An emergency operative plan for a reducible minimally symptomatic hernia would be wrong.

guideline.name: HerniaSurge — International guidelines for groin hernia management
guideline.section: Diagnosis (clinical examination, ultrasound for uncertain swellings); watchful waiting in minimally symptomatic men; mesh repair (Lichtenstein, TEP/TAPP); groin hernia in women; femoral hernia; emergency repair
guideline.citation: HerniaSurge Group. International guidelines for groin hernia management. Hernia. 2018;22:1–165.

rationale: Base case for the groin cluster. Tests that a reducible, minimally symptomatic inguinal hernia ranks top, is not escalated, and that the plan offers the HerniaSurge options (watchful waiting or mesh repair). The web CC template is the only groin template available ("Inguinal / groin hernia"); it does not match any PANE CC hint, so PANE must infer from the site answer and Q&A.
